ios.desc:
Get AR Translator now for instant AI-powered translation through speaking, taking a photo, typing, or using AR. Supporting over 100 languages, it makes communication easier than ever. Understand any language today!

Key Features:

● Photo Translation: Instantly replace foreign text in images with your language - no typing required.
● Voice Translation: Speak naturally and get AI-powered, real-time translations.
● Augmented Reality Translation: Point your camera to instantly translate words - live on screen.
● Real-Time Camera Translation: Scan full paragraphs and see translations appear instantly as you move your camera.
● Text Input: Type any phrase for fast, accurate translation.
● AI Chat: Ask questions about your text or translations and get smart, context-aware answers.
● AI Summary: Turn long articles, documents, or scanned pages into clear, concise summaries in seconds.
● 100+ Languages: Seamlessly translate between over 100 languages.
● Auto Language Detection: Automatically recognizes the source language - no guesswork needed.
● Offline Mode: Translate voice, photos, and text anytime, anywhere - no internet required.
● Listen: Hear natural-sounding audio playback of any translation.
● Share: Copy or send translations instantly with one tap.

Powered by Advanced AI

Our proprietary artificial intelligence powers both OCR and voice recognition, delivering unmatched accuracy in camera and speech translation. With AI Chat and AI Summary, you go beyond word-for-word translation - ask clarifying questions, explore nuances, and distill lengthy content into clear, actionable insights.

Join Millions of Satisfied Users

AR Translator is trusted by millions worldwide for its accuracy, speed, and innovation. With numerous 5-star reviews, our app is regularly updated to ensure the best user experience.
Whether you're a traveler, student, or professional, AR Translator is your all-in-one solution for real-time translation using your camera, text, voice, and augmented reality.

Supported Languages:

Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Burmese, Catalan, Cebuano, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Esperanto, Estonian, Farsi, Fijian, Filipino (Tagalog), Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Igbo, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer,
